article_title: Half price rail travel extended to 18-year-olds

tasks.prompt: What is the main change announced for the 16–17 Saver Railcard?
options: It will be free for every passenger under 25
It will remain valid for a full year from purchase, even after the holder turns 18
It will offer free travel only at weekends
It will be replaced by the 16–25 Railcard
tasks.correct_answer: It will remain valid for a full year from purchase, even after the holder turns 18
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכרטיס יהיה תקף שנה מלאה מיום הרכישה, במקום לפוג אוטומטית כשהמחזיק מגיע לגיל 18.

tasks.prompt: How much does the 16–17 Saver cost for one year?
What discount does the Saver give on most rail fares?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכרטיס מזכה בהנחה של 50% על רוב דמי הנסיעה ברכבת.

tasks.prompt: When is the new full-year validity rule due to begin?
options: At the end of the academic year
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי ההכרזה, השינוי נכנס לתוקף ב־17 באוגוסט 2026.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “expires” mean?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: expires פירושו שפג התוקף והכרטיס כבר אינו תקף.

tasks.prompt: If a card “entitles” a holder to half-price fares, what does “entitles” mean?
options: Gives the holder the right to receive the discount
Forces the holder to travel daily
Prevents the holder from buying tickets
tasks.correct_answer: Gives the holder the right to receive the discount
tasks.explanation_hebrew: entitles פירושו מעניק זכות לקבל הטבה מסוימת.

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference between “fare”, “valid” and “purchase” in the context of the Railcard. Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להגדיר מחיר נסיעה, תקפות ורכישה וליישם כל מילה על הכרטיס.
expected_points: A fare is the price paid for a journey
Valid means the card can legally be used during that period

tasks.prompt: Why could the old rule have treated students of the same academic year differently? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שתאריך יום ההולדת, ולא שנת הלימודים או הצורך בנסיעה, קבע מתי פגה ההנחה.
expected_points: The old card expired when a holder turned 18
Students with earlier birthdays lost the discount sooner than classmates
The new full-year rule reduces this birthday-based difference

tasks.prompt: Write a 70–100 word summary including the card’s cost, discount, old expiry rule, new rule and intended beneficiaries.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול 35 ליש״ט, חצי מחיר, הפקיעה בגיל 18, שנה מלאה מיום הרכישה ותלמידים/מתלמדים.
expected_points: The 16–17 Saver costs £35 and gives 50% off most fares
Previously it could expire when the holder turned 18
From 17 August 2026 it is valid for a full year from purchase
The change is intended to help young people travelling to education or training

tasks.prompt: Use the figures in the article to explain why the government described the extension as important for young travellers. Write 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בלפחות שני נתונים: יותר מ־70,000 צעירים, הפסד ממוצע של 175 ליש״ט, עלות הכרטיס או גובה ההנחה.
expected_points: More than 70,000 young people were said to miss the discount under the old rule
Those affected were on average £175 worse off
The card costs £35 and offers 50% off most fares
Connect the figures to travel for school, college or training
